comments.body:
Andrew Woods, it's clear that we will want to carefully check this move before we actually make it, including extensive test-driving. (I would like, if possible, even to do a little A/B performance testing, although I know that's expensive.)

Do you have any thoughts about the timing of this? Later this spring?
A. Soroka, as for timing, after April 1 but before June 1 would be good.
Sounds reasonable. Can you give me some idea of how long you'd like to see a Java 8 artifact-set in use (test use) before feeling comfortable? I don't have a strong opinion about it.

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/794

However, I will wait on committing this PR until the U-Maryland-hosted Jenkins server supports Java8.
Note: Mohamed Mohideen Abdul Rasheed Peter Matthew Eichman

Good.

https://mail-archives.apache.org/mod_mbox/jena-dev/201505.mbox/%3CF828312D-463C-416F-8E8E-64F9E0CB8A90@email.virginia.edu%3E

indicates that we may want to follow Jena carefully through the migration to Java 8 and the Streams API.
